title: Farewells
label: ch:ar-farewells
canDo: I can close a conversation in Arabic, choosing between maʿa s-salāma and ilā l-liqāʾ.

payoff.summary: The four-chapter conversation end to end -- greet, name, how-are-you, farewell -- with every -ka swapped to -ki on the second run, maʿa s-salāma written by hand, and the chapter's letters and farewells recalled from memory.
payoff.note: AR-C04-practice assesses all sixteen atoms the chapter introduces: the whole conversation and its root ledger, the shapes of ع, ه and ة and what builds مع and السلامة, the two letters of إلى اللقاء the writing has not reached, and a spoken recall of maʿa standing alone, the faʿāla pattern behind salāma, the farewell as a wish closing on s-l-m, and ilā l-liqāʾ from l-q-y.
